title: Certify complete projected centre-error endpoint response
body:
## Result

In the selected common-frame scalar projection, the complete final ordinary-owner response to all 1,152 independent centre-transport output errors has rank 1,152. All 144 paired bridges, 16 signed terminal exchanges, full local continuations and shared helper owners are retained. Thus no nonzero vector of these centre errors cancels at the complete final endpoint in this fixed projected schedule.

This answers a bounded form of PR2199's final-output-quotient handoff. Its source-history rank alone did not establish a final-output statement. The new result computes the actual error-response map; backward errors affect 227 local ordinary roles, including helper restoration. The no-error complete scalar endpoint is identity on 14,336 inputs.

## Evidence and limits

Exact Q elimination and a separately implemented prime-field elimination with opposite pivot order agree, including a listed 1,152-owner minor. Two independent literal interpreters each execute 2,835,792 scalar instructions and agree on every final owner. Missing-bridge, duplicate-column and single-error controls pass. Optimized Git-free replay, source-before-import, typed-receipt and output-refusal controls pass; registered Python 3.12 commands and details are in VERIFY.json/VALIDATION.md. Separate read-only AI proof review found no actionable issue.

Frame moves, idle factors and address translations remain explicit identity projections. This is not a native rank bound, recursive tariff, arbitrary-feedback transcript lower bound, supplier or kappa change. PR2199's unchanged verifier is vendored with source pins and credit; PR1918, PR2048, PR2391 and the selected construction/compiler lineage retain attribution. Only the new scoped package is added.
